elements.description:
I'm currently a B.Tech student in Computer Engineering at Bajaj Institute of Technology, Wardha. Beyond just hitting the books, I'm all about getting involved. You'll often find me jumping into various clubs and events, not just to pass the time but because I genuinely enjoy being a part of the action.

What makes it even better is the connections I've made along the way. I've managed to build some pretty solid bonds with both seniors and juniors. It's not just about textbooks; these relationships have added a lot of value to my college experience.

Being part of these clubs and events has opened my eyes to different sides of learning. It's not just about lectures and exams; it's about taking what you've learned and applying it to real-world scenarios.

I'm here to dive into opportunities, build connections, and make the most out of my academic journey. Because after all, it's not just about the degree; it's about the experiences that come with it.

multiLocaleTitle.en_US: Official Website of Bajaj Science Education Center

elements.description:
Bajaj Science Education Centre is a place for children to learn science through exploration and play.

Redesigned previous website, revamping its user interface (UI) to enhance visual appeal, and improve overall functionality. Resulted in a visually appealing and user-friendly website that significantly improved user engagement using Figma and Tailwind CSS.

Introduced an intuitive admin panel for admin to effortlessly update and manage upcoming notices and class content for students using NextJS and Firebase, achieving a substantial time reduction of 91.67% .

Utilized Firebase Storage to store images and Firestore for database managment that allows the admin to update and view data in real-time.

Contributed to cost savings by strategically migrating the project to a free-tier hosting platform.

elements.description:
Engineered a Cafe Management System that scans QR codes and displays a digital menu, enabling customers to place orders digitally.

Incorporated a Menu Page, integrated search functionality, and designed an Orders Page using React and Redux.

Razorpay payment integration was seamlessly managed, and built APIs using Node.js and Express.js to support it.

I’ve employed Mongoose’s changeStream along with Socket.io to enable real-time updates for order.
